title: Developer quickstart visual kit — API auth, streaming wireframes, and tool-call sequences
creator: Jordan Lee
body: Deliver a compact, production-ready visual asset pack for the API/SDK quickstart pages focusing on three core flows: 1) API key creation and short-lived token flow (hosted & private), 2) streaming response UI and SDK integration patterns, and 3) tool-calling / function call sequence illustrations (authorization, schema, and response routing). Assets should include annotated wireframes, Figma components, export-ready PNG/SVGs, and a small set of copy-ready captions. Goal: reduce first-time setup confusion and lower support tickets for onboarding by demonstrating common pitfalls and recommended patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Three annotated flows (auth, streaming, tool-calls) in Figma with componentized elements
Exported artboard set (SVG + 2x PNG) named for docs ingestion
Shortline copy for each step (max 20 words per caption) ready for i18n handoff
Two engineering signoffs: SDK dev and runtime team for technical accuracy
Accessibility check: color contrast and alt-text notes included
deliverables: Figma file: "Quickstart Visual Kit / DES-9376" (master page + variants)
Design tokens and component spec document (token names matching console styles)
37x copy-ready captions in CSV for docs team
Sketch of micro-interaction for streaming (3 frames) and video demo 15s
comments: 2025-02-12 Jordan Lee: Ticket created after product review. PM asked for clear separation between hosted and private key flows.

2025-02-20 Ava Park: Ready for engineering accuracy pass; requested runtime team review by 2025-02-24. Added checklist for export naming conventions.
review_feedback: Priya Shah (ENG): Ensure the streaming wireframe shows KV cache warm-up hints and a note about chunked token boundaries.
Miguel Torres (PM): Add an optional "quick copy" button graphic for the API key step and an example of scoped key labels.
Luca Romano (Security): Add small callout about where audit logs will show key usage; flag the private deployment note for legal.
Content team: Prefer imperative verb voice for captions (e.g., "Create a scoped key", not "You can create a key").

Export assets and push to drive for docs ingestion (owner: Jordan)

notes_for_engineering: Streaming sample must show incremental parse strategy (example pseudo-code attached in PR)
Tool-calling flow should visualize the fallback policy when a tool returns a 5xx
Auth panel to include both API key creation and short-lived token exchange (client credential example)
Add subtle spinner state for long polling / streaming lines and guidance on token expiry UX
priority_context: Part of Q1 docs push; reduces support touchpoints for basic onboarding flows. High visibility in release notes.
final_export_notes: Use filename prefix DES-9376 and include variant suffixes: auth-hosted, auth-private, streaming-compact, streaming-detailed, toolcall-basic, toolcall-advanced. Include alt-text CSV in same folder.
